profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in React, TypeScript, Go, Java, and MySQL. Strong information technology professional with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science focused in both Fullstack Software Engineering & Databases.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led the development of the Albertsons Unified Design System as a front-end engineer. Collaborated closely with UX designers to create ReactJS components, with the goal of supporting various teams within the merchandising division of the organization to reduce their applications' time-to-market whilst guaranteeing a consistent user experience across applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Full-Stack)
positions.description: Collaborated in a small team of five developers to spearhead a comprehensive redesign/rebranding initiative at CharterUP. Initiated the creation of a production-ready UI application from the ground up using Vue+Vuex to modernize an aging user interface. Key accomplishments include a strategic overhaul of the pricing system for quoting charter bus trips, allowing operators to incorporate custom charges and markups. Implemented substantial updates to the backend stack (Java+Spring / MySQL), introducing new API endpoints and data structures to align with the requirements of the revamped web UI solution.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Contractor)
positions.description: Operated in a software development UI support role and tasked with maintaining eSante, an all-in-one clinical data management portal. Responsibilities included enhancing the resilience of mobile and web applications while also expanding the functionality of existing features using cross-platform technologies such as Flutter.

positions.title: Software Engineer III (Full-Stack)
positions.description:
Performed the duties of a full-stack software engineer, leveraging modern technologies and practices to design and develop a modern video annotation tool. The stack consisted of a React+Redux w/ Electron frontend and a backend REST API composed of Java+Spring / MSSQL. The tool facilitated the creation, collection, and organization of various events and bounding box annotations for use in a wide variety of internal security-based computer vision and machine learning operations.

Designed and developed a Python/Flask video-streaming service which incorporated object-detection using YOLOV3. The service was deployed to various Walmart stores running Azure ASE edge modules and provided an additional layer of in-store safety and security for both employees and customers.

positions.title: Software Engineer II (Cloud Engineer)
positions.description:
Performed the duties of a backend software engineer, leveraging Azure cloud technologies to quickly produce prototypes that either enhanced or demonstrated the viability of various business-oriented endeavors. 

Prototype applications provided the following APIs/services: data indexing, data repository management, video streaming and processing, optical character recognition, and image+video labeling/categorization.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Performed the duties of a full-stack support software engineer and worked closely with the Order Management System's product owner to gather requirements for client-funded development efforts. I designed and implemented several features and optimizations which include the following:

- Custom Item Data: Implemented custom item data functionality and corresponding filters in the Order Routing system

- Filters: Refactored filter-creation forms in the Order Routing system for robustness, added form validators, and improved the front-end user experience with an updated UI

- Type-Casting: Enabled the Order Routing system to overcome ambiguities in data received from external applications by introducing an implicit/explicit type-casting system based on filter types.

- Datasets: Refactored datatype-creation forms in the Order Routing system for robustness, rewrote dataset processing logic, and updated corresponding UI pages

- Location Service: Optimized the Order Routing logic and drastically improved UI loading times by introducing a new Location Status model and corresponding Hibernate service classes

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Performed the duties of a full-stack support software engineer, delivering quick, personalized and optimized solutions to clients' Kibo-hosted cloud-based e-commerce platforms on a client-by-client basis.

Performed code-base maintenance on the Order Management System's order routing application and redesigned a significant portion of its filter-creation backend to improve its robustness.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created a distributed, scalable, and fault-tolerant system using Amazon's elastic computing services running Apache with Tomcat 8 to host a Java backend used to preserve user session information in soft state.

System deployment was fully automated and supported automatic reinstatement of faulty nodes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Tompkins County, New York, United States
positions.description:
Created an interactive, online message board for members of the Ithaca Community Gardens to pay membership dues and schedule amenity time.

Began the development of an online payment system using the Stripe API.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Intern)
positions.description: Designed an SQL relational database schema and implemented a frontend interface to store and manage GPS, athlete, and racecourse information used by our RedRunner web application, which displayed an interactive map for spectators to track athletes live during marathon races.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented a relational database management system in C++, using a B+ tree as the underlying index data structure.

Implemented the page buffer manager with a least-recently used paging algorithm to maximize cache hits.

company.name: Term Project: Relational Database Management System

positions.title: Customer Care Specialist
positions.description: Took inbound calls from customers across the country and assisted them with customer service questions, billing inquiries and payments, and technical troubleshooting issues whilst providing excellent customer service and establishing long-term customer relations.
